entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Moriok lich-head, ruler of the Mephidross and one of the Seven Steel Thanes of New Phyrexia, compleated into Vishgraz.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Whose fall Geth helped bring about.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: Region of Mirrodin ruled by Geth.

entities.name: Yert
entities.description: Subject of Geth who allied with Glissa, was fed to the vampire, and became a vampire who overthrew Geth.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: Phyrexian who led a rebellion against Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: Sent Ixhel to assassinate Geth and branded Vishgraz heretical.

entities.name: Ixhel
entities.description: Phyrexian angel who killed Geth and created Vishgraz.

entities.name: Vishgraz
entities.description: Phyrexian Insect built from Geth's and others' parts, retaining some of Geth's memories.

events.summary: Glissa slaughters Yert's Reaper and wins his help; Geth's vampire attacks her and she defeats it, forcing Geth to tell her what she wanted.
events.quote: Geth told Glissa what she wanted to know which got her to leave more quickly

events.summary: Yert is fed to the vampire, rises as a vampire and beheads Geth, who survives as a lich-head.
events.quote: he overthrew Geth after beheading him

events.summary: After Karn's return, Geth becomes a guardian of the Mirari on a Memnite.
events.quote: Geth became one of the guardians of the Mirari

events.summary: During Phyrexian corrosion, Geth takes a Phyrexian body and wipes out contenders to reclaim the Vault of Whispers.
events.quote: he wiped out contenders to the Vault of Whispers

events.summary: Geth makes protective contracts with flawed aspirants; Atraxa sends Ixhel, who decapitates him.
Ixhel kills Belaxis and builds Vishgraz from his and Geth's parts.
events.quote: used parts from his and Geth's bodies

events.summary: Vishgraz awakens and is ordered to destroy dissenting factions with poison.
events.quote: Vishgraz awoke to life under the blinding white sky of the Fair Basilica

events.summary: Vishgraz's stolen limbs disobey; Atraxa brands it a heretic and Ixhel abandons it in the Dross Pits.
events.quote: Ixhel abandoned Vishgraz in the Dross Pits

relations.quote: to create a new Phyrexian creature named Vishgraz
he overthrew Geth after beheading him
Geth ruled the Mephidross from the throne in the Vault of Whispers
Atraxa eventually sent the Phyrexian angel Ixhel to assassinate Geth

relations.note: Agreed to help acquire the Shield of Kaldra
relations.quote: agreed to help Glissa acquire the Shield of Kaldra
